caption: A sheet of cling film is lifted off a bowl, and the film clings back to the bowl's rim and to itself.

sa.check: A bowl covered with cling film.
The film is lifted off the bowl.
The film clings back to the bowl's rim.
The film is thin and transparent.
The lift comes first and the clinging follows.

pc.expect: As the film is lifted, parts that touch the rim stay stuck to it and folds that meet stick to each other; they part only when pulled.
pc.fail: The film lifts cleanly away and hangs straight like paper touching nothing; or a part on the rim falls away by itself; or folds that meet slide apart with nothing pulling them; or the film stands out stiff from the hand.

pc.expect: The film is a thin limp sheet: it wrinkles, folds and stretches slightly where it is pulled from the rim, and peels off with a tug.
pc.fail: The film holds a flat rigid shape like a lid; or drapes in heavy folds like cloth; or stretches out long like rubber and snaps back; or tears into shards.

pc.expect: Parts of the film not stuck to anything hang downward from the hand; if let go the film falls onto the bowl or table.
pc.fail: A free edge rises or stands out sideways with nothing near it; or the film floats when let go; or the film climbs up the hand.

pc.expect: The bowl stays where it is while the film is lifted, apart from a small drag; the film moves only with the hand or as it settles.
pc.fail: The bowl lifts off the table with the film and hangs from it; or the bowl slides across the table by itself; or the film crawls over the rim after settling.

pc.expect: One sheet of film and one bowl; the film stays one piece and passes through nothing; the bowl keeps its shape.
pc.fail: The film splits into several pieces; or vanishes; or passes through the bowl; or the bowl changes shape or duplicates; or the bowl's contents appear or vanish.

pc.expect: The bowl's colour and pattern, its contents and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: The bowl changes colour; or its contents change; or the table changes.
